restore_statement_tex.M9-M1-hard-top-radical-mobius-mellin-joi: Let F_sigma(r)=C_(L,X)^sigma(r)e(sigma sqrt(Xr)) and K_L(b,u)=sum_(a|u, a^2b>L)mu(a). The complete literal high-radical sum H_(L,sigma) equals sum_(b,u)K_L(b,u)F_sigma(bu^2) exactly. Since K_L(b,u)=1_(u=1) for b>L, for every L one has H_(L,sigma)=T_(L,sigma)^M1+E_(L,sigma), where E_(L,sigma)=sum_(b<=L,u)K_L(b,u)F_sigma(bu^2)-sum_(r<=L)F_sigma(r) and E_(L,sigma)<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. Thus complete squarefree Mobius linearization returns the original hard cone modulo a target-safe correction, and joint (s,t) lifting is only a permutation of product indices. Coefficient-uniform capacity is L^2 already on the t=1 odd coprime-squarefree cone, but this is not literal lower mass. For the full-orientation Mellin fibre, odd 3 mod 4 prime exponent cancellation kills only tau=0; the truncated literal cone requires all inverse-Mellin modes and endpoints. This parks complete inversion/recombination, central-mode-only, positive noncentral-mode, coefficient-uniform, character-erased, and multiplier-averaging closures only. It neither refutes the literal small-t target nor proves a parent or exponent.

create.title: Hard-M1 small-t nonresonant primitive-ray incidence sector
create.statement_tex: For every real X>=2, every literal middle or lower residual hard-M1 shell L, and both signs sigma, expand the exact zero-extended product coefficient into divisor incidences and write h=Gu, n=Gv with G=(h,n), (u,v)=1. Put s(u,v)=sf(uv), rho(u,v)=sqrt(uv/s(u,v)), T_L=ceil(sqrt L), G_0=ceil(L^(1/4)), Delta_X(u,v)=dist(2sqrt(Xuv), Z+1/2), and delta_X=(10log(2X))^(-1). The complete signed incidence subaggregate with s(u,v)>L, G rho(u,v)<T_L, G>=G_0, and Delta_X(u,v)>=delta_X is <<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon, with the actual chi_4(G)chi_4(v) coefficient and every profile, power, floor, star, half weight, strict edge, hard sample, real-X crossing, endpoint, sign, and zero-extension field retained. The proof uses uniform step-two bounded variation of the literal ray symbol and the exact odd-G geometric ratio -e(2 sigma sqrt(Xuv)), followed by a positive sum over O((1+L/G_0)^2) primitive rays. The exact incidence-level complement is {G<G_0} union {G>=G_0:Delta_X(u,v)<delta_X}, inside all original predicates; it contains the complete t=1 face. This strict sector does not estimate the complement or prove the full small-t owner.
create.next_action: Use this theorem only after expanding the exact divisor incidences. Attack the exact remaining small-gcd or near-half-integer-resonant incidence complement, especially the complete t=1 cone, with a new literal coefficient-sensitive signed relation; do not reinterpret the sector as a subset of product indices.

update.next_action: The large-gcd nonresonant primitive-ray incidence sector is now target-safe by an actual character-phase BV argument. Prove the exact incidence complement {G<ceil(L^(1/4))} union {G>=ceil(L^(1/4)):Delta_X<(10log(2X))^(-1)}, retaining every original predicate. The first piece contains all t=1 and the second has no proved metric or signed-correlation bound. Partial Mobius truncation self-returns; the fixed-row Fejer brace is only an unproved stronger sufficient condition and is not PSC.

update.statement_tex: Let F_sigma(r)=C_(L,X)^sigma(r)e(sigma sqrt(Xr)), T=ceil(sqrt L), and K_(L,T)(b,u)=sum_(a|u, a^2b>L, u/a<T)mu(a). The literal high-radical small-t scalar equals sum_(b,u)K_(L,T)(b,u)F_sigma(bu^2) exactly. On b>L and u<T, K_(L,T)(b,u)=1_(u=1); the complementary regions b<=L and b>L,u>=T are each O_epsilon(L^(3/2)X^epsilon). Hence the small-t scalar equals the full literal product wave P_(L,sigma)=sum_r F_sigma(r) modulo O_epsilon(L^(3/2)X^epsilon). If the Mobius divisor is split at a=T, the a>=T tail is target-safe but the a<T core still equals P_(L,sigma) modulo target size because its kernel also equals 1_(u=1) on b>L,u<T. Thus target-scale partial Mobius truncation self-returns to the original product wave, including a=t=u=1. The earlier complete high-radical all-t self-return, joint-(s,t) reindexing, and noncentral-Mellin limitations remain valid. Coefficient-uniform t=1 capacity is not literal lower mass. This obstruction parks only the named automatic recombination, positive-norm, central-mode, character-erased, and truncated-Mobius shortcuts; it neither refutes the literal small-t owner nor proves a parent or exponent.
update.next_action: Park complete and target-truncated squarefree-Mobius recombination: the a>=ceil(sqrt L) tail is safe, but the a<ceil(sqrt L) core self-returns to the full product wave modulo target size and retains a=t=u=1. The exact fixed-row Fejer correlation is a distinct unproved sufficient mechanism, not PSC or the owner. Attack only a fresh literal relation on the small-gcd or near-resonant complement.
